title: A$^2$-VLA: Adapting Vision-Language-Action Policies to New Tools through Agentic Affordance Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.25656v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tools with different shapes can have similar functions, but transferring manipulation skills across tools requires understanding how tool geometry relates to the specific task and adjusting the manipulation strategy accordingly. The key challenge is to discover the common affordances that contribute to task completion across different tools and verify whether they support new tools in performing similar work. We present A$^2$-VLA, a tool-adaptation framework that combines an embodied agent with a VLA policy. It treats tool affordances as hypotheses the agent can construct, test, and revise. Given teleoperated demonstrations with a few source tools, the agent reconstructs the scenes in simulation and autonomously determines task-relevant affordance features: functional regions and their key geometric properties. It develops affordance-extraction skills and refines both the features and skills through autonomous experiments in the recons

translated_title: A²-VLA：通过智能体可供性发现将视觉-语言-动作策略适配到新工具
translated_abstract: 形状不同的工具可能具有相似的功能，但跨工具迁移操作技能需要理解工具几何结构与特定任务之间的关系，并相应地调整操作策略。关键挑战在于发现有助于完成任务的跨工具共性可供性，并验证这些可供性是否支持新工具执行类似的工作。我们提出了A²-VLA，这是一个将具身智能体与VLA策略相结合的工具适配框架。该框架将工具可供性视为智能体可以构建、测试和修正的假设。给定使用少量源工具的遥操作演示，智能体在仿真中重建场景，并自主确定与任务相关的可供性特征：功能区域及其关键几何属性。它通过在重建场景中的自主实验来发展可供性提取技能，并对特征和技能进行迭代改进。（注：原摘要文本不完整，结尾处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出A²-VLA框架，将具身智能体与VLA策略相结合，把工具可供性视为可构建、测试和修正的假设，通过在重建的仿真场景中自主发现功能区域及其关键几何属性等任务相关可供性特征，实现操作技能向新工具的迁移与适配。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes A²-VLA, a tool-adaptation framework that combines an embodied agent with a VLA policy, treating tool affordances as constructible, testable, and revisable hypotheses to autonomously discover task-relevant affordance features in reconstructed simulation scenes, enabling the transfer of manipulation skills to new tools.
